item.title: A$AP Rocky Holds Fan’s Sign Seemingly Dissing Drake During Concert: Here’s What It Said
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. We've got a juicy story for you today, straight from the world of hip-hop. It seems like the feud between A$AP Rocky and Drake is heating up again."
[Short music transition]
Host: "On Tuesday, June 30th, Rocky was performing in Seattle when he held up a fan's sign that appeared to take a jab at Drake. The sign read, 'This cutie smoked all 3 of your f–ka– albums,' with a photo of Rocky in the center. Rocky seemed to be enjoying the moment, laughing as he showed off the sign to the crowd."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But that's not all - there's also a clip of Rocky catching himself from rapping along to Drake's 2012 hit 'F–kin Problems' during the show. It's clear the two rappers are still at odds. This feud has been going on for a while, with both artists trading shots over the years."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The beef reportedly started after Yams Day in 2020, with Rocky and Drake having romantic ties to Rihanna and other women. The feud has been escalating, with both artists releasing songs that seem to diss each other. It's a wild ride, folks, and we'll be keeping an eye on it."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's the latest from the world of music. A$AP Rocky's 'Don't Be Dumb' tour is still going strong, and we'll see what's next in this ongoing feud. Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for listening!"
